shortlist.story: An AI tool predicts which emergency-room patients are at high risk of developing PTSD by analysing the stories they tell about what brought them in.
shortlist.best_title: AI Predicts PTSD Risk Based on Stories About What Brought Patients to the Emergency Room
shortlist.why: Institution-sourced, implies a completed study, AI is the specific mechanism (narrative analysis), clear health benefit outside the AI industry.

shortlist.story: An AI system at The Christie cancer centre is letting doctors spend more time with patients rather than on paperwork, as reported by a named local survivor.
shortlist.best_title: Ramsbottom cancer survivor welcomes AI helping Christie doctors focus on patients
shortlist.why: Named person, named real-world hospital, 'helping' implies current use, AI is the stated reason for the change.

shortlist.story: An AI platform described as 'game changing' is already in use by GPs and is reported to be transforming how they work day to day.
shortlist.best_title: 'Game changing' AI platform is transforming GPs' working lives
shortlist.why: Present-tense framing implies real use rather than a launch; health topic affecting a recognisable group of workers and their patients. Worth opening to confirm it's deployment not announcement.

shortlist.story: UVA Health reports an AI tool that is accelerating the discovery of new treatments for disease.
shortlist.best_title: AI Tool to Accelerate New Disease Treatments
shortlist.why: Healthcare institution as source (not an AI company), implies a result rather than a forecast, AI is the method. Worth opening to confirm evidence level.

shortlist.story: Research covered by Futurity shows an AI model can identify which people are at high risk of developing tooth decay.
shortlist.best_title: AI can predict who's at high risk for cavities
shortlist.why: Futurity reports peer-reviewed studies; practical everyday health benefit; clear AI role; wide non-specialist appeal.

shortlist.story: Flinders University researchers used AI to analyse healthcare quality in a way that captures hard-to-measure aspects of care such as patient wellbeing, not just waiting times and costs.
shortlist.best_title: AI assesses what really matters to people in healthcare – wellbeing
shortlist.why: University press release on EurekAlert, implies a completed study, AI is the reason previously unmeasured aspects are now captured, real-world healthcare impact.

shortlist.story: An AI called AlphaOracle can read 3,000-year-old Chinese oracle bone script the way scholars do, potentially unlocking around 3,000 characters that have had no agreed translation.
shortlist.best_title: An AI that reads oracle bones the way scholars do: AlphaOracle traces form, context and classical texts to 3,000-year-old characters
shortlist.why: Specific completed tool, surprising real-world cultural/scientific benefit, described in plain terms, strong mass appeal outside any specialist field.

shortlist.story: Researchers at AIMR used an AI-driven framework to discover promising new solid-electrolyte battery materials, replacing slow trial-and-error lab work.
shortlist.best_title: Beyond trial and error: A framework for AI-driven solid-electrolyte discovery
shortlist.why: EurekAlert research result, AI is the core method, climate/energy relevance, moves beyond the lab announcement framing to a concrete framework in use.

shortlist.story: A multicenter study in China developed BC-SMART, an AI that reads MRI scans, pathology slides and clinical records together to predict before surgery whether a breast cancer patient will fully respond to chemotherapy.
shortlist.best_title: AI that reads MRI, pathology slides, and clinical data together predicts breast cancer chemo response before treatment starts
shortlist.why: Multicenter study (strong evidence), AI is essential to the result, concrete clinical benefit for a recognisable group of patients, plain to explain.

shortlist.story: An Australian state is banning the practice of AI cameras issuing parking fines without a physical ticket, acting on concerns about automated enforcement.
shortlist.best_title: This Aussie state will ban ticketless parking fines from AI cameras
shortlist.why: Bad news: AI cameras handing out fines with no ticket. Good side: government acting to ban the practice — 'system is responding'. No physical injury. Widely relatable grievance for general readers.

shortlist.story: After a hack involving OpenAI, Australia is introducing mandatory reporting requirements to prevent AI systems from 'going rogue', making it one of the first countries to impose such obligations.
shortlist.best_title: Australia to introduce mandatory reporting after OpenAI hack to combat artificial intelligence 'going rogue'
shortlist.why: Bad news: an AI company was hacked, raising fears. Good side: government mandating transparency and accountability — 'system is responding'. No physical injury reported. The Guardian gives it mainstream reach.
